user.title: Connect an Aquarius Plant LED controller
user.description: This release candidate is read-only. Bounded hardware write validation did not pass, so no controller profiles are enabled for writes. Enter the controller's local address to read its six channel levels and current mode. Channel and mode changes are blocked. The integration never changes the schedule or restores lamp output on startup.

reconfigure.title: Change controller address
reconfigure.description: This release candidate is read-only; bounded hardware write validation did not pass. Update this controller's address while preserving its device, entities, and names. Use the address of the same lamp: the protocol does not expose a verified immutable device identifier. The connection check only reads state.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the controller. Check its address and connectivity from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_response: The controller returned an unsupported or invalid protocol reply. No settings were changed.

abort.already_configured: This controller address and port are already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A connection check for this controller is already in progress.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Controller address updated. Device and entity identities were preserved.
